output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; and Transfer(0, owner, mintedAmount); are executed, mintedAmount is added to target's balance without a check, causing mintedAmount to overflow and set target's balance to a very high value. This can be exploited to increase the balance of any user to a high value, allowing attackers to steal the funds.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls transfer, the balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; and balanceOf[_to] += _value; are executed, if _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow, setting target's balance to a very high value, allowing attackers to steal the funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls transferFrom, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; and balanceOf[_to] += _value; are executed, if _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow, setting target's balance to a very high value, allowing attackers to steal the funds.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls buy, the uint amount = msg.value * buyRate; and balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; are executed, if buyRate is set to a very large value, it can cause an overflow, allowing attackers to steal the funds.
